verdictHolds.reason: The 'clean' verdict holds: ins and animals merge the fix with zero conflicts and a provably byte-identical result; plants correctly stays out of scope because main hasn't adopted the fix there and this sync's own precedence rule is that main decides behaviour, never the branch inventing ahead of it. One coverage gap in the survey's own workflowRisks section, not in its conclusion (see missed): it enumerates only lighthouse.yml per repo as the workflow_run risk to check, but animals, plants and tests each also carry a second workflow_run-triggered file (e2e-tests.yml / workspace-e2e-tests.yml, triggered off 'Publish Branch Image' completion, same as lighthouse.yml) that went unexamined. Checking it directly shows the same 'none' conclusion still holds, so the survey's bottom line is unaffected -- but the coverage claim ('main changed zero .github/workflows/*.yml files... this sync therefore introduces no new workflow_run drift of any kind') implies a completeness that the file list given didn't actually demonstrate for these two files.
